adaptation: Fine-tuned from v2 for 1200 steps on 392 manually transcribed crops from six user-supplied MISA screenshots, mixed 50/50 with generated unrelated text. BatchNorm statistics frozen; learning rate 0.00001 with cosine decay.
input: float32 NCHW grayscale / 64 pixels; PIL BICUBIC; /255 then (x-.5)/.5; right-edge padding
confidence: unchanged raw minimum emitted character probability; existing caller gates
runtime: torch 2.7.1+cu126 CUDA only, strict weights_only load
validation_scope: Training completed and saved checkpoint inspected; no held-out inference, automated tests, simulator or live MISA workflow run. Training loss is not accuracy.
data_scope: Screenshots and manual rectangles are training-only data, never runtime templates, click coordinates or expected-text corrections. No data uploaded.
